title: Soccer Player Cluster
body:
Using unsupervised learning algorithms, Abby obtained two-dimensional representations for four soccer teams:
• Team O-Ski: $$(1,1)$$
• Team SantaQlaus: $$(3,1)$$
• Team Pandas: $$(5,4)$$
• Team Ice-berk: $$(1,5)$$
Abby wants to cluster the above two-dimensional representations.
